---
name: SIR documentation and issue evidence
description: Maintain accurate architecture decisions, handoffs, issue and milestone receipts.
applyTo: 'Docs/**,.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**,.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md,README.md,CONTRIBUTING.md'
---
# Documentation and evidence

- Describe what source implements today separately from intended architecture, deferred work and vendor capabilities.
- For workgroup handoffs record baseline SHA, owned files, API/ABI locks, expected outputs, test commands, receipts, acceptance criteria and known gaps.
- Link concrete source paths and tests instead of broad unsupported claims.
- Do not mark milestone/issue done unless acceptance checks and authorized GitHub issue state are verified.
- Avoid changing published specs solely to make an incomplete implementation seem compliant.
